name: 科林·麦克劳德
bio_short: 加拿大裔美国遗传学家。作为艾弗里团队的核心成员之一，他参与了1944年的经典实验（`avery_dna_principle_1944`），通过分离肺炎双球菌的转化因子，帮助确认了DNA是遗传物质。
bio_short_en: A Canadian-American geneticist. As a core member of Avery's team, he participated in the classic 1944 experiment (`avery_dna_principle_1944`), helping to identify DNA as the genetic material by isolating the transforming principle of Pneumococcus.
